2026-07-27 14:29:22.313109 | controller |
2026-07-27 14:29:22.313113 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-07-27 14:29:22.313117 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-07-27 14:29:22.313120 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-27 14:29:22.313124 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-27 14:29:22.313127 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-07-27 14:29:22.313131 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-07-27 14:29:22.313134 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
